page.layout: One column of lexicon entries in Latin and Hebrew, filling the page. No marginal notes. A Hebrew running head stands at the top centre.

main_text.p: Hiphil הִשְׁבִּיר Vendere annonam[?], item Frangere matricem[?], hoc est, Aperire ad partum. Hophal הָשְׁבַּר Confringi.
שָׁבַר m. Fractura, Fractio, Contritio: Ambiguè, quasi fanis[?] Fractura dicta quomodo dicitur frangere sit m, Psa 104.11: [illegible, ~10 letters] Explicatio, quasi rei diffusio Fractio & solutio.

מִשְׁבָּר , מִשְׁבַּר m. Matrix vel Os matricis, quod in partu frangi videtur, vel à frangentibus partus describibus sic dictum: plur. מִשְׁבָּרִים Fluctus, seu dicti quòd vel se mutuo, vel naves Confringunt.
שָׁבַשׁ Chald. Perplexum, Attonitum reddi, Obstupescere, Conturbari. Ithpahel Part. מִשְׁתַּבְּשִׁין Attoniti, Dan.5 9.
שָׁבַת Quievit, Cessavit. Niphal נִשְׁבַּת Cessare Aboleri. Hiphil הִשְׁבִּית Cessare fecit vel sivit, Abolevit, Suffulit, Amovit, Removit, Summovit.
שַׁבָּת c. Sabbathum, Cessatio, Requies, Synecdoche[?].

page.notes: Scan is faded and show-through is present at the edges. Several Latin words at line ends and the Psalm reference are doubtful; marked [?] or left illegible. No page number is printed or visible. The Hebrew of the running head is taken as the entry word שבר.
